  WHY: Every reviewer identified the same cleanup gap on the failure path; one explicitly labeled it critical, while the others described the same bug as a correctness or hardening issue.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:233-267 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The self-heal LLM sees rendered prompt text, but the patch is validated against raw prompt files that still contain `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`, so correct prompt fixes near that placeholder can be rejected.
  WHY: All six reviewers called out the same rendered-vs-raw baseline mismatch; some emphasized the Serena-hint expansion and others the blank-line fallback, but all said patch application can fail for a valid fix.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:214-233 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `build_self_heal_serena_tool_hints` never returns failure, so the `|| true` at the call site is dead code and the helper always emits Serena hints when available.
  WHY: The reviewer treated this as a separate issue because the helper is unconditionally successful and therefore cannot signal an error path.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:583 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `while IFS='=' read -r env_key env_value` will mis-parse future env-file values containing additional `=` characters.
  WHY: The reviewer described it as a theoretical brittleness concern, not a current runtime failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:233-267 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The self-heal prompt assembly renders every allow-listed validation prompt file through `render_prompt.sh`, while patch application still checks the raw on-disk files that contain the literal `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` line.
  WHY: When Serena is available or unavailable, the rendered view differs from the raw file near the top of each prompt, so a unified diff produced against the rendered view can be rejected by `patch` or `git apply` when applied to the raw file.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:577-580
  PROBLEM: When `scripts/setup_serena.sh` exits non-zero, `ensure_serena_bootstrap` does not call `clear_stale_serena_codex_config`.
  WHY: The other early-return paths already clear stale Serena config, so a setup failure can leave a stale `[mcp_servers.serena]` registration behind in `~/.codex/config.toml`.
